title: Getaway to Sri Lanka
highlights: Soak in the charm of Sri Lanka, where golden beaches, ancient temples, and lush landscapes create a unique blend of history, nature, and culture.
Get a rare sight as orphaned elephants are being fed and bathed in the river at Pinnawala, a sanctuary dedicated to their rescue and rehabilitation.
Witness the stunning Kandyan dance performance, a traditional art form characterized by energetic drumming and vibrant costumes, offering a glimpse into the island's history and rituals.
Marvel at the perfect blend of traditional and modern architecture at Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple, offering a glimpse into Sri Lanka’s cultural and religious heritage.
overview:
About the Tour:
Sri Lanka, a teardrop island-studded in the Indian Ocean characterized by its colonial architecture, and Buddhist temples, stunning beaches, is a perfect destination for spending some time with your loved ones. Take a moment and see the whopping range of activities and experiences it offers to everyone who set foot in its picture-perfect landscapes.
Begin your amazing tour by visiting the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and watching the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways. Awaken the adventurous soul in you by indulging in a myriad of water sports for fun and thrill in Bentota from jet skiing, banana boat ride, parasailing, paramotoring, speed boat ride, yachting, canoeing, kayaking, to boating in the mangrove forests. Conclude this tour by visiting the Red Mosque, a stunning candy-like red and white striped mosque named ‘Jami Ul-Alfar’ is the most spectacular building in your entire trip in Colombo.

Route: Kandy - Bentota - Colombo
Duration: 4 Days 3 Nights
Start Point: Bandaranaike International Airport (Colombo)
End Point: Bandaranaike International Airport (Colombo)

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | En route visit to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Transfer to Kandy | Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show
days.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon arrival, get driven to Kandy. En route, make a stop at the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage & witness the care given to orphaned elephants, including feeding and bathing sessions. Continue your journey to Kandy and upon reaching, check-in to your hotel. Later, enjoy a scenic drive around Upper Lake, offering stunning views of the surrounding hills and water below. Also, witness the Kandyan dance performance, showcasing the island's rich traditions through music & dance.

items.title: Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show

days.title: Transfer to Bentota | En Route visit to Perandeniya Botanical Gardens | Boat Ride at Madu River
days.desc: Post check-out, enjoy a scenic drive to Bentota. En route, make a stop at the Perandeniya Botanical Gardens & witness over 4000 species of plants. Also, stroll through the famous Royal Palm Avenue before continuing your journey. Upon arrival in Bentota, check-in to your hotel & relax. In the evening, get driven to the Colombo Port Passenger Terminal & board your boat for a ride along the serene Madu River. As you glide through the calm waters, soak in the amazing views of the vibrant ecosystem.

items.title: Visit to Peradeniya Botanical Garden, Kandy
Madu Ganga Boat Safari | Balapitiya River Safari

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, after check-out, get driven to Colombo, the capital of Sri Lanka. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax. Later, explore this stunning coastal city on a sightseeing tour & visit the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple, known for its stunning traditional architecture. Next, soak in the vibrant atmosphere of the Galle Face Green & stroll through the historic Colombo Fort, a testament to the city. Continue to the Lotus Tower, offering stunning city views & explore other attractions.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check-out from your hotel in Colombo. Then, board your transfer and get driven to the airport for your flight back home, marking the end of your amazing Sri Lanka trip!
